_convention: User-facing feature highlights for the What's New panel. NEWEST-FIRST (index 0 is the newest — it drives the 'New' badge via latestHighlightId()). This is a hand-curated CONSOLIDATION of many releases into a short story, decoupled from the raw dev changelog (changelog.json). Keep copy plain-language and unphased (no 'Phase 1/2'). Add a new theme to the TOP when something notable ships; trim the tail so the list stays ~6-10 items. Each item: { id, title, blurb, since (version it first landed), date (ISO), href?, cta? }.

highlights.title: What-if Bracket Simulator
highlights.blurb: Play out the rest of the knockouts your way — pick the winners of unplayed matches and watch how the whole pool would re-rank under your scenario. Unlock it once by beating a quick football-trivia challenge, then you get two committed runs a day.

highlights.title: The live knockout bracket
highlights.blurb: The full knockout tree with live team names and scores, a check-mark on every slot that matches your picks, and eliminated teams greyed out. Tap any chip to jump straight to that match. It's a wallchart on desktop and a swipeable carousel on mobile.

highlights.title: Match-by-match breakdowns
highlights.blurb: Tap any fixture to see exactly what's at stake for you — your pick, the points it banks, and how far that team can still carry you through your bracket. Plus the pool's split on who backed whom.

highlights.title: A cleaner Results page
highlights.blurb: Every knockout round now opens with one card showing your whole bracket for that round in a single read — alive picks ticked, missed picks struck through, with a running points summary. On wider screens you get two fixtures per row, so a full round fits without scrolling.

highlights.title: Live group standings
highlights.blurb: Live tables for all twelve groups plus the best third-placed race, refreshed every minute with the full FIFA tiebreaker chain applied. See at a glance which of your predicted qualifiers are locked in, which have slipped, and how your Round of 32 bracket has shifted.

highlights.title: A brand-new Leaderboard
highlights.blurb: Standings with pool filters and search, a Race chart tracking every rank across the tournament, and Insights cards — plus a detail drawer to open any entry's full picks and scoring. It's the whole pool at a glance.

highlights.title: Smart Fill your picks
highlights.blurb: Short on time? Auto-populate your predictions from FIFA rankings or live betting odds, then fine-tune whatever you like before submitting — no more staring at a blank wizard.
